design: One known Python regression and five new public topics. Same queries, top two URLs, 20k read limit; provider order rotates by case. Single trial; no tuning after results.

search_review.top1_relevance: 0 irrelevant/unusable; 1 broadly related or wrong specified version; 2 direct topic with partial match; 3 directly answers the question
also_review: actual readable body and excerpt support

hard_fail: critical claim unsupported by supplied excerpts without disclosure
answer_review.note: Codex manual review, not external judge accuracy or a general benchmark.

cases.question: Python 3 列表的 append 和 extend 有什么区别？请用一个小例子说明，指出返回值。
cases.query: Python 3 append extend 区别 site:docs.python.org
expected_facts: append adds one item, including a nested list as a single item
both mutate the list and return None
cases.projection_terms: append extend iterable None 列表 返回值

cases.question: DeepSeek 新开放的 Search 和 Fetch 分别做什么、怎么计费？搜索摘要能直接当网页正文证据吗？
cases.query: DeepSeek Search Fetch API 2026 价格 成功请求 正文 site:api-docs.deepseek.com
expected_facts: Search returns search results; Fetch returns a specified page as Markdown
billed by successful requests with usable results, not tokens or number of returned results
summary is not the fetched original page; Fetch remains subject to site access
cases.projection_terms: Search Fetch 计费 成功 价格 正文 Billing successful summary need_content

cases.question: Swift 里调用 task.cancel() 就会立刻停掉任务吗？任务应如何配合取消？
cases.query: Swift Task cancel cooperative cancellation checkCancellation site:docs.swift.org
expected_facts: cancellation is cooperative, not forced thread termination
checkCancellation throws or isCancelled can be checked to return/clean up
unchecked work may keep running, including work whose final check has passed
cases.projection_terms: cancel cancellation cooperative checkCancellation isCancelled Task 取消

cases.question: In PostgreSQL, can two SELECTs in one transaction see different committed data under Read Committed? How is Repeatable Read different?
cases.query: PostgreSQL Read Committed Repeatable Read snapshot successive SELECT site:postgresql.org/docs
expected_facts: Read Committed normally takes a new snapshot for each statement
Repeatable Read uses the snapshot at the first non-control statement
cases.projection_terms: Read Committed Repeatable Read snapshot SELECT first statement

cases.question: Does Cache-Control no-cache mean nothing is stored? How does no-store differ?
cases.query: Cache-Control no-cache no-store revalidate difference RFC 9111
expected_facts: no-cache can permit storage but requires validation before reuse
no-store forbids intentional storage for request/response
neither is a blanket security/privacy guarantee

cases.question: 检索练习为什么可能比反复重读更利于长期记忆？能否把这个结论理解为任何时候测试都更好？
cases.query: 检索练习 反复重读 长期记忆 testing effect Roediger Karpicke 2006
expected_facts: retrieval practice can improve delayed retention beyond additional study
immediate performance and delayed retention differ
not a universal guarantee for all materials or contexts
cases.projection_terms: retrieval practice testing effect retention repeated study delay 长期 重读
